<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<title>Cronograma de Entregas — Boulevard 5</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy-deep:#030328;
    --navy:#0a052c;
    --blue-fade:#0573b0;
    --accent:#04b0d6;
    --grey:#5b6770;
    --white:#ffffff;
    --ink:#000000;
    --glass-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    --glass-bg-strong: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
    --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
    --text-primary: rgba(255,255,255,0.96);
    --text-secondary: rgba(255,255,255,0.62);
    --text-muted: rgba(255,255,255,0.40);
    --radius-lg: 22px;
    --radius-md: 16px;
    --radius-sm: 10px;
    --shadow-soft: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;}
  html,body{margin:0; padding:0; height:100%;}
  body{
    font-family:'Poppins', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
    color:var(--text-primary);
    background:
      radial-gradient(1100px 620px at 12% -10%, rgba(5,115,176,0.35), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(900px 560px at 110% 10%, rgba(4,176,214,0.22), transparent 55%),
      radial-gradient(1200px 800px at 50% 120%, rgba(5,115,176,0.18), transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(160deg, var(--navy-deep) 0%, var(--navy) 55%, #070420 100%);
    background-attachment: fixed;
    min-height:100vh;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  ::selection{ background: var(--accent); color: var(--navy-deep); }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar{ width:10px; height:10px; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{ background: transparent; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{ background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 10px; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{ background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

  .wrap{
    max-width: 1360px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 22px 22px 60px;
  }

  /* ---------- Header ---------- */
  .glass{
    background: var(--glass-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(140%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(140%);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  }

  header.topbar{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:18px;
    padding: 16px 22px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .brand-lockup{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:14px;
  }
  .brand-lockup img{ display:block; }
  .logo-puerta{ height:40px; width:auto; filter: brightness(0) invert(1); opacity:0.95; }
  .logo-divider{
    width:1px; height:32px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
  }
  .logo-blvd{ height:22px; width:auto; filter: brightness(0) invert(1); opacity:0.92; }

  .title-block{ text-align:right; }
  .title-block h1{
    margin:0; font-size: 15px; font-weight:600;
    color: var(--text-secondary); letter-spacing:.02em;
  }
  .title-block .accent-text{
    font-size: 20px; font-weight:700;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff, var(--accent));
    -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
    display:block; margin-top:2px;
  }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    margin-top:18px;
    padding: 26px 28px;
    position: relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background: radial-gradient(500px 220px at 90% -20%, rgba(4,176,214,0.35), transparent 70%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hero h2{
    margin:0 0 6px; font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px); font-weight:700;
  }
  .hero p{
    margin:0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size:14px; max-width:680px; line-height:1.55;
  }
  .hero-badges{ display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .badge-pill{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    padding:8px 14px; border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--glass-bg-strong);
    border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    font-size:12.5px; color: var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .badge-pill b{ color: var(--text-primary); font-weight:600; }
  .badge-dot{ width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; }

  /* ---------- Stats ---------- */
  .stats-row{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    gap:14px;
    margin-top:18px;
  }
  .stat-card{
    padding:16px 18px;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;
  }
  .stat-card .num{ font-size:26px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.02em; }
  .stat-card .lbl{ font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary); font-weight:500; }
  .stat-card.accent-border{ border-color: rgba(4,176,214,0.4); }

  /* ---------- Toolbar ---------- */
  .toolbar{
    margin-top:18px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:12px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .search-box{
    flex:1 1 220px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
    border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 9px 12px;
  }
  .search-box svg{ flex-shrink:0; opacity:.55; }
  .search-box input{
    background:transparent; border:none; outline:none;
    color:var(--text-primary); font-family:inherit; font-size:13.5px; width:100%;
  }
  .search-box input::placeholder{ color: var(--text-muted); }

  select.filter-select{
    appearance:none; -webkit-appearance:none;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.18) url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="6" viewBox="0 0 10 6"><path d="M1 1l4 4 4-4" stroke="%23ffffff" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>') no-repeat right 12px center;
    border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    font-family:inherit; font-size:13px;
    padding: 9px 30px 9px 12px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  select.filter-select option{ background:#0a052c; color:#fff; }

  .week-nav{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    margin-left:auto;
  }
  .nav-btn{
    width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    color:var(--text-primary);
    cursor:pointer;
    transition: background .15s ease, transform .15s ease;
  }
  .nav-btn:hover{ background: rgba(4,176,214,0.3); }
  .nav-btn:active{ transform: scale(0.92); }
  .week-label{
    font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; min-width:190px; text-align:center;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-radius: 999px;
  }
  .today-btn{
    padding: 9px 16px;
    border-radius:999px;
    border:1px solid rgba(4,176,214,0.5);
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(5,115,176,0.35), rgba(4,176,214,0.35));
    color:#fff; font-family:inherit; font-size:13px; font-weight:600;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .today-btn:hover{ filter:brightness(1.15); }

  /* ---------- Sync bar ---------- */
  .syncbar{
    margin-top:14px;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .sync-status{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--text-secondary); }
  .sync-dot{
    width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0;
    background: var(--text-muted);
    transition: background .2s ease;
  }
  .sync-dot.live{ background:#4ee9ab; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(78,233,171,.7); }
  .sync-dot.error{ background:#f38b8b; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(243,139,139,.6); }
  .sync-dot.demo{ background:#f7b955; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(247,185,85,.5); }
  .sync-dot.loading{ background: var(--accent); animation: pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes pulse{ 0%,100%{opacity:1;} 50%{opacity:.35;} }
  .refresh-btn{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    padding: 7px 14px; border-radius:999px;
    border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color:var(--text-primary);
    font-family:inherit; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .refresh-btn:hover{ background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }
  .refresh-btn svg{ transition: transform .4s ease; }
  .refresh-btn.spinning svg{ transform: rotate(360deg); }

  /* ---------- Calendar grid ---------- */
  .calendar{
    margin-top:18px;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    gap:14px;
  }
  .day-col{
    padding:0;
    overflow:hidden;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    min-height: 240px;
  }
  .day-col.is-empty-day{ opacity:.55; }
  .day-head{
    padding:14px 16px 12px;
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  }
  .day-head .dname{ font-size:12.5px; color:var(--text-secondary); font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; }
  .day-head .ddate{ font-size:19px; font-weight:700; margin-top:2px; }
  .day-head .dcount{ font-size:11px; color:var(--accent); margin-top:4px; font-weight:600; }

  .day-body{ padding:12px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; flex:1; }

  .slot-card{
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 11px 12px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
    cursor:pointer;
    transition: transform .15s ease, background .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
  }
  .slot-card:hover{
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(4,176,214,0.18);
  }
  .slot-card .hora{ font-size:11px; color: var(--accent); font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.03em; }
  .slot-card .cliente{ font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; margin-top:3px; line-height:1.3; }
  .slot-card .apto{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-top:2px; }
  .slot-card .meta-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-top:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }

  .chip{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;
    font-size:10px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em;
    padding: 3px 8px; border-radius:999px;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .chip-tipo{ background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); color:var(--text-secondary); }
  .chip-estado-completada{ background: rgba(4,214,140,0.18); color:#4ee9ab; }
  .chip-estado-confirmada{ background: rgba(4,176,214,0.20); color:#5fd8ef; }
  .chip-estado-programada{ background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .chip-estado-reprogramada{ background: rgba(245,166,35,0.20); color:#f7b955; }
  .chip-estado-cancelada{ background: rgba(239,68,68,0.20); color:#f38b8b; }

  .slot-card.empty-slot{
    cursor:default;
    border-left: 3px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    border-style: dashed;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size:12px;
    min-height:64px;
  }

  /* ---------- Footer / allies ---------- */
  .footer{
    margin-top:22px;
    padding: 20px 24px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .allies{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:22px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .allies .ally-label{ font-size:11px; color:var(--text-muted); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em; margin-right:6px;}
  .allies img{ height:22px; width:auto; filter: brightness(0) invert(1); opacity:.75; }
  .footer-note{ font-size:12px; color:var(--text-muted); max-width:420px; line-height:1.5; text-align:right; }

  /* ---------- Modal ---------- */
  .modal-overlay{
    position:fixed; inset:0; background: rgba(3,3,40,0.65);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    z-index:50; padding:20px;
    opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition: opacity .18s ease;
  }
  .modal-overlay.open{ opacity:1; pointer-events:auto; }
  .modal-card{
    width:100%; max-width:420px;
    padding:26px;
    transform: translateY(10px) scale(.98);
    transition: transform .18s ease;
  }
  .modal-overlay.open .modal-card{ transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  .modal-card h3{ margin:0 0 4px; font-size:19px; font-weight:700; }
  .modal-card .modal-sub{ font-size:12.5px; color:var(--accent); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:16px; }
  .modal-row{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:14px; padding:9px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); font-size:13px; }
  .modal-row:last-of-type{ border-bottom:none; }
  .modal-row .k{ color:var(--text-secondary); }
  .modal-row .v{ font-weight:600; text-align:right; }
  .modal-close{
    margin-top:18px; width:100%; padding:11px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border:1px solid var(--glass-border);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color:var(--text-primary);
    font-family:inherit; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .modal-close:hover{ background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }

  .empty-state{
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    text-align:center; padding: 50px 20px; color:var(--text-muted);
  }

  @media (max-width: 980px){
    .stats-row{ grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); }
    .calendar{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .title-block{ text-align:left; }
    header.topbar{ justify-content:flex-start; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

  <header class="topbar glass">
    <div class="brand-lockup">
      <img class="logo-puerta" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Puerta Abierta Inmobiliaria" />
      <div class="logo-divider"></div>
      <img class="logo-blvd" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Boulevard 5" />
    </div>
    <div class="title-block">
      <h1>Puerta Abierta Inmobiliaria</h1>
      <span class="accent-text">Cronograma de Entregas · Boulevard 5</span>
    </div>
  </header>

  <section class="hero glass">
    <h2>Entregas de apartamentos — Septiembre en adelante</h2>
    <p>Vista semanal de las firmas de escritura y entregas de unidades. 4 entregas diarias, de 9:00 a.m. a 6:00 p.m., de lunes a viernes. Actualiza el Excel semana a semana y compártelo para refrescar esta vista.</p>
    <div class="hero-badges">
      <div class="badge-pill"><span class="badge-dot" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>4 entregas / día</div>
      <div class="badge-pill"><span class="badge-dot" style="background:var(--blue-fade)"></span>9:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.</div>
      <div class="badge-pill"><span class="badge-dot" style="background:#4ee9ab"></span>Lunes a viernes</div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="syncbar glass" id="syncBar">
    <div class="sync-status">
      <span class="sync-dot demo" id="syncDot"></span>
      <span id="syncText">Cargando…</span>
    </div>
    <button class="refresh-btn" id="refreshBtn">
      <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 11-3-6.7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M21 4v5h-5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      Actualizar ahora
    </button>
  </section>

  <section class="stats-row" id="statsRow"></section>

  <section class="toolbar glass">
    <div class="search-box">
      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M21 21l-4.3-4.3" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
      <input id="searchInput" type="text" placeholder="Buscar cliente o apartamento..." />
    </div>
    <select class="filter-select" id="tipoFilter">
      <option value="">Todos los tipos de pago</option>
      <option value="FHA">FHA</option>
      <option value="Crédito Directo">Crédito Directo</option>
      <option value="Contado">Contado</option>
    </select>
    <select class="filter-select" id="estadoFilter">
      <option value="">Todos los estados</option>
      <option value="Programada">Programada</option>
      <option value="Confirmada">Confirmada</option>
      <option value="Completada">Completada</option>
      <option value="Reprogramada">Reprogramada</option>
      <option value="Cancelada">Cancelada</option>
    </select>
    <div class="week-nav">
      <button class="today-btn" id="todayBtn">Hoy</button>
      <button class="nav-btn" id="prevWeek" aria-label="Semana anterior">
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M15 18l-6-6 6-6" stroke="white" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      </button>
      <div class="week-label" id="weekLabel">—</div>
      <button class="nav-btn" id="nextWeek" aria-label="Semana siguiente">
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M9 18l6-6-6-6" stroke="white" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="calendar" id="calendarGrid"></section>

  <footer class="footer glass">
    <div class="allies">
      <span class="ally-label">Aliados del proyecto</span>
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Forma" />
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Grupo Orión" />
    </div>
    <div class="footer-note" id="footerNote">
      Esta vista se sincroniza automáticamente con la hoja de cálculo publicada en Google Sheets. Si algo no cuadra, edita la hoja y presiona "Actualizar ahora" (o espera la actualización automática).
    </div>
  </footer>

</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="modalOverlay">
  <div class="modal-card glass">
    <h3 id="modalCliente">—</h3>
    <div class="modal-sub" id="modalAptoHora">—</div>
    <div class="modal-row"><span class="k">Fecha</span><span class="v" id="modalFecha">—</span></div>
    <div class="modal-row"><span class="k">Tipo de pago</span><span class="v" id="modalTipo">—</span></div>
    <div class="modal-row"><span class="k">Banco</span><span class="v" id="modalBanco">—</span></div>
    <div class="modal-row"><span class="k">Estado</span><span class="v" id="modalEstado">—</span></div>
    <div class="modal-row"><span class="k">Notas</span><span class="v" id="modalNotas">—</span></div>
    <button class="modal-close" id="modalClose">Cerrar</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// ============================================================
// CONFIGURACIÓN DE SINCRONIZACIÓN EN VIVO
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Opción A — Airtable: pega un Personal Access Token de SOLO
// LECTURA, limitado a esta base, en AIRTABLE.token.
// Opción B — Google Sheets / OneDrive (recomendado): pega el
// enlace "Publicar en la web" (formato CSV) en CSV_URL.
// Si AIRTABLE.token tiene valor, tiene prioridad sobre CSV_URL.
// Si ambos están vacíos, la app muestra datos de ejemplo.
// ============================================================
const CONFIG = {
  AIRTABLE: {
    baseId: "appZfmz8ZpexJroDP",
    tableId: "tblM0DcFFJzmOUgqt",
    token: "", // pat... (solo lectura, alcance data.records:read, limitado a esta base)
  },
  CSV_URL: "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vT00s9PiHS42ibx24eovghsraQkGQL4ff_izvMum8e4xQoKUKLfMxkYHyifv0vxsWvhg0CFwmB9Cd--/pub?gid=1833420654&single=true&output=csv",
  AUTO_REFRESH_MINUTES: 5,
};

const DEMO_DATA = [];
let DELIVERIES = DEMO_DATA;

const DIAS_ORDEN = ["Lunes","Martes","Miércoles","Jueves","Viernes"];
const DIAS_ORDEN_FULL = ["Lunes","Martes","Miércoles","Jueves","Viernes","Sábado","Domingo"];
const MESES = ["enero","febrero","marzo","abril","mayo","junio","julio","agosto","septiembre","octubre","noviembre","diciembre"];

function parseLocalDate(iso){
  const [y,m,d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
  return new Date(y, m-1, d);
}
function mondayOf(date){
  const d = new Date(date);
  const day = (d.getDay() + 6) % 7; // 0=Mon
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - day);
  d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  return d;
}
function fmtDayMonth(d){
  return d.getDate() + " " + MESES[d.getMonth()].slice(0,3);
}
function isoOf(d){
  const y=d.getFullYear(), m=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'), day=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}
function fmtTime(d){
  return d.toLocaleTimeString('es-GT', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'});
}

// ---------- CSV parsing (RFC4180-ish) ----------
function parseCSV(text){
  const rows = [];
  let row = [], field = '', inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++){
    const c = text[i];
    if (inQuotes){
      if (c === '"'){
        if (text[i+1] === '"'){ field += '"'; i++; }
        else inQuotes = false;
      } else field += c;
    } else {
      if (c === '"') inQuotes = true;
      else if (c === ','){ row.push(field); field = ''; }
      else if (c === '\n'){ row.push(field); rows.push(row); row = []; field = ''; }
      else if (c === '\r'){ /* skip */ }
      else field += c;
    }
  }
  if (field.length || row.length){ row.push(field); rows.push(row); }
  if (!rows.length) return [];
  const headers = rows[0].map(h => h.trim().toLowerCase());
  return rows.slice(1)
    .filter(r => r.some(v => (v||'').trim() !== ''))
    .map(r => {
      const obj = {};
      headers.forEach((h, idx) => obj[h] = (r[idx] || '').trim());
      return obj;
    });
}

function parseFlexibleDate(str){
  str = (str || '').trim();
  let m = str.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
  if (m) return `${m[1]}-${m[2]}-${m[3]}`;
  m = str.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})/); // dd/mm/yyyy (formato del Excel)
  if (m){
    const dd = m[1].padStart(2,'0'), mm = m[2].padStart(2,'0'), yyyy = m[3];
    return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
  }
  return null;
}

function mapCsvRowToRecord(row){
  const fechaIso = parseFlexibleDate(row['fecha']);
  const cliente = (row['cliente'] || '').trim();
  if (!fechaIso || !cliente) return null; // slots vacíos del Excel se ignoran
  const d = parseLocalDate(fechaIso);
  return {
    fecha: fechaIso,
    dia: DIAS_ORDEN_FULL[(d.getDay() + 6) % 7] || '',
    hora: (row['hora'] || '').trim(),
    cliente,
    apartamento: (row['no. apartamento'] || row['apartamento'] || '').trim(),
    tipo: (row['tipo de pago'] || row['tipo'] || '').trim(),
    banco: (row['banco'] || '').trim(),
    estado: (row['estado'] || 'Programada').trim(),
    notas: (row['notas'] || '').trim(),
  };
}

// ---------- Airtable mapping ----------
function mapAirtableRecordToRecord(rec){
  const f = rec.fields || {};
  const cliente = (f['Cliente'] || '').trim();
  const fechaIso = (f['Fecha'] || '').trim(); // Airtable ya entrega YYYY-MM-DD
  if (!cliente || !fechaIso) return null;
  const d = parseLocalDate(fechaIso);
  let banco = (f['Banco'] || '').trim();
  if (banco === 'N/A') banco = '';
  return {
    fecha: fechaIso,
    dia: DIAS_ORDEN_FULL[(d.getDay() + 6) % 7] || '',
    hora: (f['Hora'] || '').trim(),
    cliente,
    apartamento: (f['No. Apartamento'] || '').trim(),
    tipo: (f['Tipo de Pago'] || '').trim(),
    banco,
    estado: (f['Estado'] || 'Programada').trim(),
    notas: (f['Notas'] || '').trim(),
  };
}

async function fetchAirtableRecords(){
  const { baseId, tableId, token } = CONFIG.AIRTABLE;
  let all = [];
  let offset;
  do {
    const url = new URL(`https://api.airtable.com/v0/${baseId}/${tableId}`);
    url.searchParams.set('pageSize', '100');
    if (offset) url.searchParams.set('offset', offset);
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
      cache: 'no-store',
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const json = await res.json();
    all = all.concat(json.records || []);
    offset = json.offset;
  } while (offset);
  return all;
}

// ---------- Sync status UI ----------
const syncDot = document.getElementById('syncDot');
const syncText = document.getElementById('syncText');
const refreshBtn = document.getElementById('refreshBtn');

function setSyncStatus(kind, text){
  syncDot.className = 'sync-dot ' + kind;
  syncText.textContent = text;
}

async function fetchLiveData(){
  const useAirtable = !!CONFIG.AIRTABLE.token;
  const useCsv = !useAirtable && !!CONFIG.CSV_URL;

  if (!useAirtable && !useCsv){
    setSyncStatus('demo', DEMO_DATA.length ? 'Mostrando datos de ejemplo — falta configurar Airtable o el enlace de Google Sheets.' : 'Sin conexión configurada — falta el enlace de Airtable o Google Sheets.');
    DELIVERIES = DEMO_DATA;
    return;
  }

  const sourceLabel = useAirtable ? 'Airtable' : 'Google Sheets';
  refreshBtn.classList.add('spinning');
  setSyncStatus('loading', `Sincronizando con ${sourceLabel}…`);
  try{
    let records;
    if (useAirtable){
      const raw = await fetchAirtableRecords();
      records = raw.map(mapAirtableRecordToRecord).filter(Boolean);
    } else {
      const res = await fetch(CONFIG.CSV_URL, {cache: 'no-store'});
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
      const text = await res.text();
      records = parseCSV(text).map(mapCsvRowToRecord).filter(Boolean);
    }
    // Un resultado vacío es válido (aún no hay entregas cargadas) — no es un error de conexión.
    DELIVERIES = records;
    setSyncStatus('live', records.length
      ? `Conectado a ${sourceLabel} · Actualizado ${fmtTime(new Date())}`
      : `Conectado a ${sourceLabel} · Sin entregas registradas todavía · ${fmtTime(new Date())}`);
  } catch(err){
    console.error('Error al sincronizar:', err);
    setSyncStatus('error', `No se pudo conectar con ${sourceLabel}${DEMO_DATA.length ? ' — mostrando datos de ejemplo.' : '.'}`);
    DELIVERIES = DEMO_DATA;
  } finally {
    refreshBtn.classList.remove('spinning');
  }
}

// Build week list from data range (always show at least current real-world week's data range)
let weeks = [];
let currentWeekIndex = 0;

function computeWeeks(){
  const prevMonday = weeks[currentWeekIndex] ? weeks[currentWeekIndex].getTime() : null;
  const allDates = DELIVERIES.map(r => parseLocalDate(r.fecha));
  let minDate = allDates.length ? new Date(Math.min(...allDates)) : new Date();
  let maxDate = allDates.length ? new Date(Math.max(...allDates)) : new Date();
  let firstMonday = mondayOf(minDate);
  let lastMonday = mondayOf(maxDate);

  weeks = [];
  for (let d = new Date(firstMonday); d <= lastMonday; d.setDate(d.getDate()+7)){
    weeks.push(new Date(d));
  }
  if (weeks.length === 0) weeks.push(mondayOf(new Date()));

  if (prevMonday !== null){
    const idx = weeks.findIndex(w => w.getTime() === prevMonday);
    currentWeekIndex = idx !== -1 ? idx : nearestWeekIndexToToday();
  } else {
    currentWeekIndex = nearestWeekIndexToToday();
  }
}

function nearestWeekIndexToToday(){
  const nowMonday = mondayOf(new Date());
  let idx = weeks.findIndex(w => w.getTime() === nowMonday.getTime());
  if (idx === -1){
    let best = 0, bestDiff = Infinity;
    weeks.forEach((w, i) => {
      const diff = Math.abs(w.getTime() - nowMonday.getTime());
      if (diff < bestDiff){ bestDiff = diff; best = i; }
    });
    idx = best;
  }
  return idx;
}

const statsRow = document.getElementById('statsRow');
const calendarGrid = document.getElementById('calendarGrid');
const weekLabel = document.getElementById('weekLabel');
const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
const tipoFilter = document.getElementById('tipoFilter');
const estadoFilter = document.getElementById('estadoFilter');

function estadoChipClass(estado){
  const map = {
    'Completada':'chip-estado-completada',
    'Confirmada':'chip-estado-confirmada',
    'Programada':'chip-estado-programada',
    'Reprogramada':'chip-estado-reprogramada',
    'Cancelada':'chip-estado-cancelada'
  };
  return map[estado] || 'chip-estado-programada';
}

function currentFilters(){
  return {
    q: searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase(),
    tipo: tipoFilter.value,
    estado: estadoFilter.value
  };
}

function matchesFilters(rec, f){
  if (f.tipo && rec.tipo !== f.tipo) return false;
  if (f.estado && rec.estado !== f.estado) return false;
  if (f.q){
    const hay = (rec.cliente + ' ' + rec.apartamento).toLowerCase();
    if (!hay.includes(f.q)) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function renderStats(){
  const f = currentFilters();
  const filtered = DELIVERIES.filter(r => matchesFilters(r, f));
  const total = filtered.length;
  const completadas = filtered.filter(r => r.estado === 'Completada').length;
  const confirmadas = filtered.filter(r => r.estado === 'Confirmada').length;
  const programadas = filtered.filter(r => r.estado === 'Programada').length;
  const alerta = filtered.filter(r => r.estado === 'Reprogramada' || r.estado === 'Cancelada').length;

  const cards = [
    {num: total, lbl: 'Entregas totales', accent:false},
    {num: completadas, lbl: 'Completadas', accent:false},
    {num: confirmadas, lbl: 'Confirmadas', accent:true},
    {num: programadas, lbl: 'Programadas', accent:false},
    {num: alerta, lbl: 'Requieren atención', accent:false},
  ];
  statsRow.innerHTML = cards.map(c => `
    <div class="stat-card glass ${c.accent?'accent-border':''}">
      <div class="num">${c.num}</div>
      <div class="lbl">${c.lbl}</div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function openModal(rec){
  document.getElementById('modalCliente').textContent = rec.cliente;
  document.getElementById('modalAptoHora').textContent = `${rec.apartamento} · ${rec.hora}`;
  const d = parseLocalDate(rec.fecha);
  document.getElementById('modalFecha').textContent = `${rec.dia}, ${fmtDayMonth(d)} de ${d.getFullYear()}`;
  document.getElementById('modalTipo').textContent = rec.tipo;
  document.getElementById('modalBanco').textContent = rec.banco || 'N/A';
  document.getElementById('modalEstado').textContent = rec.estado;
  document.getElementById('modalNotas').textContent = rec.notas || 'Sin notas';
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('open');
}
document.getElementById('modalClose').addEventListener('click', () => {
  document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('open');
});
document.getElementById('modalOverlay').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (e.target.id === 'modalOverlay') e.currentTarget.classList.remove('open');
});

function renderCalendar(){
  const monday = weeks[currentWeekIndex];
  const weekDates = [];
  for (let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const d = new Date(monday);
    d.setDate(d.getDate()+i);
    weekDates.push(d);
  }
  const sunday = new Date(monday); sunday.setDate(sunday.getDate()+4);
  weekLabel.textContent = `${fmtDayMonth(monday)} – ${fmtDayMonth(sunday)}, ${sunday.getFullYear()}`;

  const f = currentFilters();
  const weekIsos = weekDates.map(isoOf);
  const weekRecords = DELIVERIES.filter(r => weekIsos.includes(r.fecha) && matchesFilters(r, f));

  if (weekRecords.length === 0 && f.q === '' && f.tipo === '' && f.estado === ''){
    // still render empty day columns (no data scheduled that week)
  }

  calendarGrid.innerHTML = weekDates.map((d, idx) => {
    const iso = isoOf(d);
    const dayName = DIAS_ORDEN[idx];
    const dayRecords = weekRecords.filter(r => r.fecha === iso).sort((a,b) => a.hora.localeCompare(b.hora));
    const slotsHtml = dayRecords.length ? dayRecords.map(r => `
      <div class="slot-card" data-key="${r.fecha}|${r.hora}|${r.cliente}">
        <div class="hora">${r.hora}</div>
        <div class="cliente">${r.cliente}</div>
        <div class="apto">${r.apartamento}</div>
        <div class="meta-row">
          <span class="chip chip-tipo">${r.tipo}</span>
          <span class="chip ${estadoChipClass(r.estado)}">${r.estado}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('') : `<div class="slot-card empty-slot">Sin entregas programadas</div>`;

    return `
      <div class="day-col glass ${dayRecords.length===0 ? 'is-empty-day':''}">
        <div class="day-head">
          <div class="dname">${dayName}</div>
          <div class="ddate">${fmtDayMonth(d)}</div>
          <div class="dcount">${dayRecords.length} entrega${dayRecords.length===1?'':'s'}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="day-body">${slotsHtml}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');

  // attach click handlers
  calendarGrid.querySelectorAll('.slot-card:not(.empty-slot)').forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const [fecha, hora, cliente] = el.dataset.key.split('|');
      const rec = DELIVERIES.find(r => r.fecha===fecha && r.hora===hora && r.cliente===cliente);
      if (rec) openModal(rec);
    });
  });
}

function renderAll(){
  renderStats();
  renderCalendar();
}

document.getElementById('prevWeek').addEventListener('click', () => {
  currentWeekIndex = Math.max(0, currentWeekIndex - 1);
  renderAll();
});
document.getElementById('nextWeek').addEventListener('click', () => {
  currentWeekIndex = Math.min(weeks.length - 1, currentWeekIndex + 1);
  renderAll();
});
document.getElementById('todayBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  currentWeekIndex = nearestWeekIndexToToday();
  renderAll();
});
[searchInput, tipoFilter, estadoFilter].forEach(el => {
  el.addEventListener('input', renderAll);
  el.addEventListener('change', renderAll);
});

refreshBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
  await fetchLiveData();
  computeWeeks();
  renderAll();
});

async function init(){
  await fetchLiveData();
  computeWeeks();
  renderAll();
  if (CONFIG.CSV_URL && CONFIG.AUTO_REFRESH_MINUTES > 0){
    setInterval(async () => {
      await fetchLiveData();
      computeWeeks();
      renderAll();
    }, CONFIG.AUTO_REFRESH_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);
  }
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
